hack.root_cause: Insider rug — deployer upgraded implementation to malicious contract → drained WBTC deposits
hack.description: Kokomo Finance was a lending protocol on Optimism, less than a week old at time of the rug, with its KOKO token launched just 36 hours before. The attack was conducted by the protocol's own deployer.
